description: Working-tree remediation of uncovered structured-count regressions and cached-FTS verification false alarms; no publication or installed-host change.

provenance.status: Uncommitted implementation, tests, generated runtime and documentation. Prior evidence is historical, not a measurement of these sources.

control_construction.plain: git show 6a19822060a0e1de099e65582632e724a6af04cf:packages/nmnm-core/src/index.js; replace the single ensurePerformanceIndex(db) call with // Indexless temporary benchmark control. No other changes.

methodology.read_pairs: Three rotating plain/before/current comparisons per visibility/statistics combination, read-only connections after writable setup.
methodology.stale_statistics: Dense profiles receive live-index cardinality/first-prefix estimates scaled down by 100; sparse profiles receive dense estimates. Statistics changes occur only in disposable benchmark stores.
methodology.tail: All 81 prior-v2/main single-run p50/p95 candidates above both 20% and 0.2ms were repeated in three alternating 100-sample pairs on identical fixtures. Lifecycle setup is outside timings.
methodology.budgets: Storage <=25%; median paired create/content overhead <=20%; reject latency regressions exceeding both 20% and 0.2ms in all three pairs.
methodology.cold: Fresh connection with warm OS cache, not cold disk.
methodology.quality: Proposed relevance labels are unchanged and unreviewed. No ranking, semantic retrieval or provider-compliance claim.

resolution.index_strategy: Single compact epoch-seconds recency index with source, expiry, namespace, kind, scope, importance, confidence and constant-null removal coverage. Only recognized v1/v2 definitions are retired atomically. No automatic statistics maintenance.
resolution.planning: Original recency/namespace/source hints remain gated by recognized definitions. Newly covered kind/scope/score and tag/FTS candidates retain planner choice, including selective user indexes. Read-only v2 stores retain source hints. Sequential counts can be selected after analysis on some runtimes.
resolution.verification: A bounded SELECT rowid FROM memories_fts LIMIT 1 opens a cursor inside the existing read snapshot before PRAGMA integrity_check, refreshing connection-local FTS state without repair, writes, error suppression or a new connection.
resolution.regressions: Genuine FTS structure/segment and ordinary-index corruption still fail verification. Empty FTS, WAL snapshots, both legacy upgrades, atomic rollback, lock-time conflicts, case-sensitive SQL literals, coexistence and full-range UTC milliseconds/UUID ties are covered.

acceptance.write_variance: One reused-content pair exceeded 20% (30.14%); the other two and aggregate stayed within budget. Timing evidence is bounded, not a population-wide guarantee.

validation.production_audit: High-severity gate passed; four existing moderate advisories remain. Manifests and locks are unchanged.
validation.limits: OpenCode native/terminal and rendered UI browser matrices were not rerun for this core-only follow-up; their previous evidence remains historical. Repository adapter suites, standalone packages, runtime floors and fresh Pi lanes were rerun. No native Codex registration, live-provider, desktop/IDE or accessibility acceptance is claimed.

parity.verification_caveat: Current verification passes before refreshed MATCH after original-core metadata and content mutations; original/current/generated read results and mutations remain equal.

fts_matrix_scope: Mixed-version opens may install another optional index and invalidate schema caches. Same-version regression tests and original-core metadata/content writes verified before MATCH establish the refresh independently of schema changes.

quality.label_status: Proposed relevance judgments; operator review required before Gate R quality acceptance.
